tei:div.tei:p: (ra pur tshogs 'don bzhin no/)(āḥ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza badzra warṇa nī ye/

bla ma rje btsun mus pa chen po dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rje btsun bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// rje btsun mkha' spyod mchod pa'i cho ga 'di// rje btsun mus pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir du// rje btsun gong ma'i gsung bzhin 'dir bshad bya// rgyud sde kun gyi yang zab gsang mtha' yi// lam bzang kun gyi bcud bsdus rnal 'byor ma'i// sgrub dkyil kun gyi nang nas rab gsal 'di// 'gro ba kun gyi nyams su len phyir spel// ngo mtshar dal 'byor lan gcig thob dus 'dir// ngo mtshar sa skya'i yab chos yang snying mchog /ngo mtshar 'di 'dra nyams len skal ba 'di// ngo mtshar las kyang mchog tu ngo mtshar lags// skal bzang kho bo'i rjes 'jug slob ma rnams// skal bzang lam 'dir spro bas rab zhugs la// skal bzang mang po 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod kyis// skal bzang grangs med mkha' spyod 'dren par mdzod// ces mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang spro ba bskyed pa'i tshig sngon du btang nas/ 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga rang bzo'i skyon spangs nas/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab bzhin bkod pa la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po bsod nams gsog par 'dod na/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/ sgrib pa sbyong bar 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcu ste/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis sogs dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ rang nyid kyi sgrub khang la sogs pa dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas byi dor byas par/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma chos skyong sogs kyi bris 'bur gyi sku yod na tshul bzhin bshams la 'thas shing ngos snyoms pa'i sa gzhi'am/ maṇḍal lam shing gi stegs bu la sogs pa gang yang rung bar/

dri bzang gi chus byugs/ khru gang la sogs pa'i tshad kyi zlum skor bya/ nang gi zlum skor dang mthun par chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi thig gdab/ de la tshon bkye ba ni chos 'byung gnyis dmar po/ thig gi gcod mtshams re khā dkar po/ nang gi zlum skor dang chos 'byung gi bar gyi khyams rnams ljang khu/ mu khyud sngon po/ yang na khyams sngon po la mu khyud ljang khur bya ba'ang bshad pas gang bde bya'o// mu khyud kyi phyi nang gnyis ka'i re khā dkar po/ chos 'byung gnyis dbus su tshon spungs dkar po dgu byas pa'i/ rtse mo rnams brdal ba'i dbus ma'i steng du tshon spungs dmar po bya/ gzhan brgyad po ni padma'i 'dab ma mtshon byed du gsungs so// de ni sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin la/ 'di nyid 'jug pa bde bar 'dod pas ras sam dar dmar po sogs la bris pas kyang rung bar bshad cing*/ de'i steng du mañdzi la sogs pa'i khar/ rdo thod dam/ thod pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du chang la sbrang ngam bu ram la sogs pa sbyar/ bdud rtsi ril bu'i phye btab pa dpral ba rang nyid la phyogs par bzhag de'i steng dar dmar ram ras dmar po kha bcad de/ de ni gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor yin zhing*/ de'i khar rin po che'am gang yang rung ba'i maṇḍal zlum po gcig gi steng*/ dri ma med par byas pa gur gum mam chang gis byugs pa la/ sindhu ra'i phye ma brtsegs pas khye ma med par bkram ste/ gser gyi thur ma'am/ med na rdo rje'i rtse mos chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su/ rgya yig gam bod yig gang yang rung ba'i bam̐ yig bris pa'i mthar mdun nas g.yon skor gyis oṃ gsum ma'i sngags mgo phyir 'khor yug tu bri/ de yang*/ oṃ gsum de'i rjes su/ sarba dang*/ buddha dang*/ ḍā ki dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badzra dang*/ warṇa dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badzra dang*/ bai ro/ tsa nī ye dang*/ hūm̐ gsum dang*/

phaṭa gsum dang*/ swā hā rnams rim bzhin g.yon skor du bri ba ma gtogs 'bru re re nas bzlog pa mi mdzad cing yi ge thams cad dbu can du bri/ 'di'ang shar drang por oṃ dang*/ byang du ḍā dang*/ nub du warṇa dang*/ lhor nī bris na cha snyoms par 'gyur zhing*/ yang bla ma gong ma'i phyag len 'khrul med chos 'byung bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa shing sogs la brkos nas par du btab chog pa yod tshe lag len bzhin btab la/ chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba re re bri ste/ de ni thugs sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin no// de rnams kyi steng du dar dmar ram ras dmar gang rung ba'i gur khang legs par phub/ de'i mtha' skor du/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar lho 'jig rten pa'i lho nub tu mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog gzhan chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga g.yon skor du bshams/ mchod pa bshams tshul 'di ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi zhal 'jig rten pa'i lhor gzigs pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ phyogs gzhan rnams la de'i rigs pas shes shing bde mchog lū nag ltar dkyil 'khor gyi zhal 'jig rten pa'i lhor bstan kho na nges par dgos pa yang ma yin no// gzhan yang gong gi bris 'bur gyi sku'i drung du/ gtor ma dam rdzas lnga'am/ bdun nam/ bcu gcig gam/ gcig la sogs pa dang*/ bskang gtor sogs rang rang gi phyag len bzhin bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs par bum gdan padma 'dab brgyad dam nas 'bras sogs 'bru gang 'byor gyi tshom bu brgyad la/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig mgul chings dmar pos dkris/ kha nas gu gul gyis bdug sumbha ni bzlas shing zhabs nas yungs kar gyis brabs la bzhag kha rgyan ku sha gtsang ma/ dung chos/ rdo rje gzungs thag bum nang du chu gtsang ma la dri bzang dang*/ bdud rtsi ril bu sogs bla med nas gsungs pa'i bum rdzas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa sbyar/

bum rdzas tshang ma ye ma 'byor na/ nang mchod nas ji ltar rigs pa dang dri bzang bsres pas rung*/ gzhan yang rdo rje dril bu ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba maṇḍal chung ngu me tog nas dang bcas pa dang*/ sgrub grogs rnams kyi mdun du'ang rdor dril ḍā ma ru nang mchod dung chos rnams dang*/ rnga cha lang dung la sogs pa dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa 'dus par bya ba ni sbyor ba'i chos so// //spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod de/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba ni/ mchod g.yog pas sngon 'gro gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs nas/ phyag gsum btsal la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang*/ dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bi dya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ badzra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni sa ma ya st+wa dṛ shya hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsi/ udmā da/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yāe/ dā ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ grihṇantu sa ma ya rakṣantu ma ma sarba siddhi me pra ya tstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thai ṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārya/ sat+su khaṃ/ bi shuddhe/ sa hā yi ka bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ arghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing srin lag gis nang mchod kyang dbul/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad kun// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams// dpal chen bka' bstod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*// mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod// sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun spyod cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// dge legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ sa'i phyogs 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ deng nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung zhing*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i stongs grogs mdzod/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig oṃ sumbha ni sogs brjod/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol/ mchod g.yog pas gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro// de nas gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal te/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin rlabs gnang ba zhu/ zhes dang*/ dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ sumbha ni sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhas yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa/

dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ rol chen dang*/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍi ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pra dzñā pa ra mi ta/ na da swa bha wen badzra dharmā hri da ya santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ tshar gsum gyi dang pos mchod yul spyan drangs/ gnyis pas mchod yul de rnams kyi gnas khang byin gyis rlabs/ gsum pas mchod rdzas la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// de nas zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad bde kyai ltar byas/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri steng du dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam pa la/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi thugs gsung sku'i lha/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i rgyab khaṇḍa ro hi'i mdun du chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu ste/ de yang gtso bo ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo/ chos po ti'i rnam pa ni chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rang bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod pas skyabs yul gsal btab 'di ni skyabs yul gyi dmigs pa rgyas pa'i lugs te/ bsdus pa ltar na/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bla ma dkon mchog thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam pa'am/ yang na bla ma dkon mchog dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngo bo rnam pa dpa' bo rje btsun chos kyi skur bsgom par bshad do// de nas skyabs 'gro dngos ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/

chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// nyi shu rtsa gcig bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gtso bo bla ma 'od sngon por zhu/ rang gi snying khar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ chos po ti 'od dmar por zhu/ mgrin par thim/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'khor gyi lha rnams 'od dkar por zhu/ dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod par bya/ de'i phyir du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o//

tshar gsum/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan zhing zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs yab kyi sku gang*/ rdo rje'i lam brgyud/ yum gyi padmar babs/ yum gyi sku gang yab yum gnyis ka'i sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang*/ rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs par gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛḍho me bha wa/ su to shyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po shyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karmā su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri ya ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa badzra he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig

/gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ de nas/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gnas pa de nyid gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod/ de gsal gdab pa ni sku'i dga' ba yin la/ de nas rang gi mdun gyi nang mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang bcas pas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying gar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin bam̐ yig bsam ste/ de la bdud rtsi phul bas zag med kyi bde bas thugs rgyud tshim par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi myang ngo*// de yang snying khar bam̐ yig bsgom pa thugs kyi dga' ba/ bdud rtsi myang ba gsung gi dga' ba yin par gsung ngo*// de nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid dpa' bo rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba bsnams pa/ gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas bdag la dges shing bzhugs pa mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/

de nyid la blo kha zhe med par gtad de/ bdag skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang*/ re sa ltos sa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che khyed rang mkhyen snyam pa'i dad gus dung dung pa dang bcas thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum zhe thag pa nas gsol ba btab ste bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags la/ de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis bla ma de nyid 'od du zhu nas thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'dres te/ bde stong gi rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar e yig gnyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum gnyis brtsegs nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar g.yon skor gyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang nyid rnam snang rigs bdag dang bcas pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid can/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes brjod cing bsgom pa ni bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa'o// de nas 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas/ chos 'byung gnas gzhal yas khang dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can la phog pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas dpa' bo dang dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su g.yon du bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ 'gro ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ de nas lag pa gnyis pad skor dang bcas pas 'khyud rgya byas/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas go cha dgod pa ni/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/

dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ go cha dgod pa 'di ye shes pa zhugs pa'i snga rting gang la bsgom kyang 'gal ba med de/ sngon la bsgom pa rgyud gzhung phal cher gyi dgongs pa yin zhing*/ rting la bsgom pa jo bo nā ro ta pa'i man ngag yin gsungs pas 'dir ni de nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin no// de ltar go cha dgod pa'i rjes su bskyed rim la sems 'dzin gyi dmigs pa tsam zhig bsgom la/ de nas bzlas pa la gnyis kyi dang po ngag bzlas bya ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ de dag gi sna las phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa sprul te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la phul bas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can gyis mnyes pas rang gi tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa dag yang 'od zer des sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par nam mkha' gang ba byon nas/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/

oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lnga brgya dang stong la sogs pa'am/ tha na yang brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i dam bca' las mi nyung ba bzla ba gal che ste/ spyir gsang sngags thams cad kyi zab mo'i mthar thug pa ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor 'di rnams yin par gsungs shing*/ de'i yang zab mthar thug pa ni rje btsun lū nag dril gsum gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim rnams yin la/ de dag gi don gyi snying po ma lus pa 'dus pa man ngag gi yang rtser gyur pa ni nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam 'di nyid yin par gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang sgrub bya'i yul du gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang de rnams bye ba phyed dang bzhi ru 'dus pa yin la/ de yang stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'dus shing*/ de yang sum cu rtsa bdun du 'dus/ de yang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am brgyad dam lngar 'dus/ de yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di kho na la 'dus pas/ 'di nyid gcig pu bsgom zhing bsgrubs pas/ mkha' 'gro ma bye ba rab 'byams ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa bsgom par 'gyur ba dang*/ de bzhin du 'di'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma yang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi ngo bo 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sngags thams cad 'dus par bshad/ de la dgongs nas bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bde mchog lū nag gi byin rlabs drug skor gyi skabs dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha thams cad kyi bzlas sngags la yum gyi nye snying kho na bzlas chog par gsungs pa yin la/ des na gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma 'di la chig sgril du byas pas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi thugs 'khul zhing byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma lan gcig tsam brjod pas kyang bskal pa mang po'i sgrib pa 'dag par nges pa yin te/

de'i rgyu mtshan gsang sngags pa rnams tshe gcig lus gcig la dngos grub thob pa'i gnad kyang 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi zab gnad dang ldan pa las 'byung ba yin par gsungs pa sogs rtsod pa dang bral ba'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis gsung rgyun dag las/ spyir mi lus lan gcig tsam thob dus 'dir gsang sngags zab mo'i lam nyams su len pa shin tu skal ba bzang ba'i tshul dang*/ lhag par mkha' spyod dbang mo 'di nyid kyi bzlas sgom nyams su blangs pa phan yon gzhan las che ba'i rgyu mtshan sgrub byed mang du 'byung yang 'dir ni ma spros la/ shes par 'dod na kho bo'i ngag las stsal bar bya'o// de nas yid bzlas bya ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa lte bar babs te de'i chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba rnams la sems gtad/ ces brjod cing bsam la rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ de nas 'og rlung bskum/ steng rlung mnan te kha sbyar bum pa can bzung la gong du gsal btab pa'i dga' ba 'khyil ba rnams la sems gtad pa'i ngang nas/ yid kyis bam̐ yig gi mtha' ma'i sngags phreng g.yon skor du klog tshul byed cing phreng ba la grangs bzung*/ rlung ci thub kyi bar la oṃ gsum ma bzla/ mi thub pa dang rlung dal bu'i sgo nas glod do// yid bzlas 'di ni rdzogs rim mtshan bcas yin pas drod dang bde ba skye zhing*/ 'phar g.yo drag tu 'byung la/ de byung na rim gyis glod do// du ba la sogs pa'i rtags thams cad kyang 'di nyid las 'byung bar bshad do// de nas yid bzlas kyi rlung dal bus btang grub pa dang*/ bzlas pa bsdu ba ni phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing phreng ba mgo thog tu bzhag de nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste/ de yang gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas lus kyi bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas lus kyi smad kyi cha la thim/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba chos 'byung nyis brtsegs la thim/ de zla ba la thim/ de sngags phreng la thim/ de bam̐ yig la thim/ bam̐ yig khog pa mgo bo la thim/ de zla tshes la thim/ de thig le la thim/ de nā da la thim/ de yang je phra je phrar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/ ces brjod cing don bsam la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de nas rtog pa 'phro na/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭaḥ

ces brjod pas go cha dgod par gsal btab la// ༈ /de nas rang gi mdun gyi nang mchod dang mañdzi'i steng gi gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la byin rlabs rgyas par bya ba ni/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su go las ba glang gi sha/ shar du ku las khyi'i sha/ byang du da las glang po che'i sha/ nub tu ha las rta'i sha/ lhor na las mi'i sha/ de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ dbus su bi las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang sems/ nub tu mam̐ las klad pa/ lhor ra las rakta/ de rnams kyi dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bhrūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nub tu dzrīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ lhor ām̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar zhing*/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par byung nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim pas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi la thim/

kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gsum char la gtor la/ sumbha ni sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ de'i steng du pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu mda'i drwa ba dang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar g.yon skor gyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nā ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/

sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyangs pa dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes brjod pas mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa bskyed/ de nas ye shes pa bstim zhing go cha dgod pa dang dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa rnams ni/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de nas 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas go cha dgod pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/

dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams la rdo rjes nang mchod gtor sumbha ni sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi steng gi cha la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis bskor ba dang bcas pa kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa tsam gyis sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bar bzhugs par bsam la de rnams mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa la mchod par bsam pas/ rang gi snying kha nas mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas so sor thogs pa mang du sprul nas/ mchod yul thams cad la mchod pa phul bas mnyes par bsam la/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/

zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ stong gsum= /lha rdzas zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba sogs sngon du 'gro bas badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ stong gsum= /lha rdzas me tog ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba sogs dang*/ puṣpe/ zhes pas me tog dang*/ stong gsum= /lha rdzas bdug spos ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba sogs dang*/ badzra dhū pe/ zhes pas bdug spos dang*/ stong gsum= lha rdzas mar me ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba sogs dang*/ badzra ā lo ke zhes pas mar me/ stong gsum= /lha rdzas dri mchog ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba sogs nas/ badzra ghandhaṃ zhes pas dri chab dang*/ stong gsum= /lha rdzas zhal zas ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sarba sogs nas/ badzra nai wi dye/ zhes pas zhal zas dang*/ stong gsum= /lha rdzas rol mo ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba sogs dang*/ badzra shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ zhes pas rol mo ste/ ghaṇḍe ra ṇi sa rol chen dang bcas pa rnams rang rang gi sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis phul ba ste phyi mchod do// na bza'i mchod pa ni/

rten khebs la sogs gos zung la/ rdo rjes bdud rtsi gtor/ sumbha ni sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa/ 'jam pa/ yang ba/ lha re re la zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mkha' spyod phag mo'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra waṣṭa ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas lha re re la stod g.yogs smad g.yogs phul bar bsam/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las mchod pa'i lha mo rnams sku mdog rgyan cha lugs so sor mchod rdzas rnams thogs pa spros te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mchod par bsams la/ spro ba'i sngags dngos ni/ oṃ wi ni badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ zhes brjod/ dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi waṃ ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs pi waṃ sgra yis mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra 'di sgra snyan bsgyur tshul gyi phyag rgya byed bi ni badzri nī badzra pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la mchod par bsam/ de bzhin du/ oṃ waṃ sya badzri ni hūm̐ aḥ gser bzang mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gling bu'i sgra yis mchod// oṃ āḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ waṃ sya badzri ni pu dzi ti āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra mṛ taṃ ge badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ padma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rdza rnga ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha'i gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta

sogs dang*/ 'di la rnga spo logs nas brdung tshul byed/ badzra mṛ taṃ ge badzri ni pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ murdzi badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga zlum ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnga zlum sgra yis mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ murdzi badzra ni badzra pū dzi te hūm̐ āḥ oṃ ha sya badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ li khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhad pa'i bde bas mchod// 'di la rnga steng nas brdung tshul byed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ oṃ ha sya badzri ni badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ la sya badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg mo ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sgeg mdzes bde bas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ la sya badzra pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ girti badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs snyan pa'i glu yis mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ gīrti badzri ni badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ nirti badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ pri yang ku mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mdzes pa'i gar gyis mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ nirti badzri ni badzra pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puṣpaṃ badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs me tog sil mas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta

sogs dang*/ puṣpaṃ badzra ni badzra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dhu paṃ badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ ind+ra ni la'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bdug pa'i sprin gyis mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ dhu paṃ badzri ni badzra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dī paṃ badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje mar me ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mar ma'i phreng bas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ dī paṃ badzri ni badzra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ghandhaṃ badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ sindhū'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dri bzang byugs pas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ ghandhaṃ badzri ni badzra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ rū pa badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gzugs kyi bde bas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta

sogs dang*/ rū pa badzri ni badzra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ra sa badzra ni hūm̐ āḥ btsod kyi mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ro yi bde bas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ ra sa badzri ni badzra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ parṣ+ya badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs reg bya'i bde bas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ parṣ+ya badzri ni badzra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ 'di la gos zung lag pas blangs la dbul tshul byed/ oṃ dharmā dha tu badzri ni hūm̐ āḥ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs chos khams bde bas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ dharmā dha tu badzri ni badzra pū 'di la nor bu mig gsum pa'i phyag rgya byed tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rnams rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis phul ba ste/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'o// rin chen sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las rin chen sna bdun rim pa bzhin du gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mchod par bsam ste/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra tsakra ratna pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad nas// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang ma ṇi ratna pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ wasti ratna pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ mahā sta ratna pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal te// bla med theg pa rab zhon nas// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ hasti ratna pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ tu raṃ ga a shwa ratna pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// snyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ khaḍga ratna pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas phul ba ste/ rin chen sna bdun gyi mchod pa'o// 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ mchod pa ji snyed yod pa rnams/ bsdu na dngos su bshams pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa'i gzugs la sogs pa/ mchod pa'i khyad par gyi mchod par mos te phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshims byed sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta

sogs dang*/ shabda kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshims byed rnams// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ ghandhe kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshims byed pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ parṣe kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas 'dod yon lngas mchod/ de nas nang mchod bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar ba'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod la 'bru gsum brjod cing g.yon du lan gsum chos 'byung bri tshul gyis bskor la dbus nas blangs te gtor bas/ rdul phra rab dang mnyam pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur par mchod par bsam la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa khri chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' theg chen dpal 'bar 'phrin las bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

rang rang gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma byin rlabs gang la thob pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod pa'o/ /zhes pas thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma la phul nas de'i rjes su brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos// mkha' spyod dbang mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub pa'i sar bzhugs paṇa chen nā ro pa// pham thing sku mched gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung dus 'khor ba/ zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// zab yangs chos kyi gter gyur shes rab brtsegs// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mal lo'i zhabs// rdo rje 'chang dngos bla chen sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gnas lnga rig pa sa skya paṇa chen dang*// 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa'i zhabs// rim gnyis thugs gzhol dkon mchog dpal ba dang*// brag phug chos rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// 'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// gdams pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan pa// shar chen ye rgyal ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun dga' bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// rgyal ba gnyis pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po seṅge'i mtshan// sa bcu'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas rin chen dang*// sa skya lo tsā'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// shes bya kun mkhyen dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje// gang gi thugs sras bsod nams dbang po dang*// grags pa blo gros zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// bla ma lhar gzigs sangs rgyas dpal bzang dang*// mkhas grub chen po dpal ldan rgyal po'i zhabs// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter gyur bzang po dpal// paṇa chen nam dbang zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// grub chen sbas pa'i sangs rgyas chos dbang phyug /de sras dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog /'khor lo sdom pa ngur smrig bla gos can// sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// (thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams dang*// grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs// sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis dang*// bsod nams rin chen zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag kun dga' blo gros dang*// de sras thu bo dbang sdud snying po'i mtshan// rje btsun 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*// kun dga' rin chen zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

'gro ba'i mgon po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang*// 'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen zhabs// rnal 'byor dbang mo skal bzang chos nyi dang*// karma ratna'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog /dran pas snying gi gdung ba sel mdzad pa// rdo rje 'chang dngos 'jam dpal bzang po sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/) /gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang*// chos kyi kho bo spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan dang grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan las kyang 'di'i chos skor thob yod kyang*/ gcig chog rgyal po rgyal ba mus pa chen po dang dbyer med du byas nas nang mchod 'bul ba'i lugs su byas te/ brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba'i bla ma mang po'i mtshan rnams 'dzin 'don gnyis ka la dka' bar bsams nas 'dir ma bris so/ 'brel ba thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug tu thig le byas/ phung khams skye mched lha'i ngo bor gsal ba bde bas tshim par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ oṃ shrī ma hā ka la ye/ ma hā kā li de wi ye/ dharmā pa la tsa turmu kha badzra ka la yakṣa/ kā li yakṣi ni yakṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha tra/ ru lu rakṣa si/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang*/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshandho dang nye ba'i tshandho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ rjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam gyi lhar bsam la 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye ba gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod la bdud rtsi lce thog tu myang bas bdag bskyed kyi lha mnyes par bsam ste/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'o// yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ gang ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings la ngag tu/

na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig se gol gcig gtogs/ yang sngags kyi phyag rgya snying khar bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya a warta ya hoḥ na maḥs mānta/ buddha nan/ a bi sma ra ye/ spha ra ṇa/ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharmā dha tu/ a ka shā sa manta māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta parṣa dha la maṇḍa le/ ma ma pra ṇi dha na/ puṇya dzñā na ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta bhandha ni/ swa stha/ ba le na tsa swā hā/ phyag rgya bkrol la se gol lan gnyis su gtogs/ de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ ḍā dril rol chen dang bcas pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badzra wa ra hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ na mo ārya a pā ra dzi te trai lo kya mā te mahā bi dye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha ya wa he ma hā badzre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra a sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa shyaṅka ri ne tra bhra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa ni shwa ṣa ni ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na massaṃ trā sa ni mā ra ni su pra bhe da ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥpa rā dza ye bi dzaḥye dzambha ni stambha ni mo hā ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra wā ra hī ma hā yo gi ni ka me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pas bstod/ de nas dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bstod pa 'dis kyang bstod par bya ste/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// dang ba'i yid kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi// 'dab brgya'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// padma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma// mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// chags chen skyes bu 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir// brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dpal dang*// gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyis rol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che// 'gyur med dga' ba gya nom bla na med// rgyun chad med pa'i bde ba'i ros gang ma// mkha' spyod bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzes pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma// mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang*// thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus la// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ma// mkha' spyod snying rjes yongs gang la phyag 'tshal// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yis// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas// rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// mkha' spyod rgyun chad med la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rje'i gzhan gyi dbang gyur nas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par rab bzhugs ma// mkha' spyod 'gog pa med la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// mkha' spyod sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// dus gsum ngag dang yid kyis rab bzlas pas// srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spangs brjod bral gsung*// mkha' spyod gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam// sgrib gnyis sbyangs phyir brtson pas legs bsgom pas// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas// tshe 'di nyid dam bar do la sogs par// mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog

ces bstod la spros pa la dga' na skabs 'dir zab mo'i yang rtse nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam rim zab mo'i don rnams bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs par mdzod cig snyam du mdun bskyed kyi mkha' spyod dbang mo dang rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis su med pa la kha zhe med par blo lhing khel gyi ngang nas thal mo snying khar sbyar la gdangs dang bcas pas/ de ltar bdag gi byang chub bar gyis skyabs// bla ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i dkyil 'khor la// mchod cing bstod pas rab tu dgyes mdzad nas// bsam don 'di rnams yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi// ba dan dkar pos bskyod pa'i las 'bras kyi// blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas// 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar mdzod// skyabs gsum gser gyi cod pan spyi bor bcings// byang chub sems gnyis nor bu'i do shal mdzes// rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes ltung dri ma bkrus// bslu med bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par mdzod// yid 'ong rgyal yum phyi yi rnal 'byor ma// bam̐ yig nang gi rdo rje btsun mo'i mchog /sems nyid stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum// rang zhal mthong ba'i rtse dgas rol par mdzod// snod kyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal med khang*// bcud kyi sems can bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// cir snang dag pa'i snang bar 'char bar mdzod// de ltar bskyed rim gsal bas pho nya mchog /rigs ldan mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab dus// dbu mar rlung zhugs gnyis med ye shes 'bar// ma rig sgo nga'i sbub chen 'byed par mdzod/ 0 /sgyu ma mkhan po 'khrul 'khor gnad la mkhas// gdol ba srog gi gnad la mkhas pa dang*// shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa ltar// kun kyang lus kyi gnad la mkhas par mdzod// rtog bcas sems dang zag bcas lus bskyed pa// rtsa gnas so sor zhugs pa'i rlung sems rnams// dbu mar thim pas mi rtog chos sku dang*// zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob mdzod// thun chen drug la thun chung sum cu po// re re re re 'phel ba goms pa'i mthus// rlung sbyor rgyal po dpal ldan kumbha kas// las rlung ma lus dbu mar zhugs par mdzod// lte ba'i padmor rlung lnga'i ti la ka

/rtse gcig bsgoms pas kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyis// lus sems rtsa la dri bzhon zhugs pa yis// bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par mdzod// lus sems rtsa la rlung rnams rim zhugs pa// de tshe tshor bde mi rtog bde ba dang*// mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes legs skyes nas// gsal la rdzogs pa'i rtags bcu 'char bar mdzod// sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i las kyi gtum mo dang*// bde chen 'khor lo'i 'od kyi gtum mo gnyis// chos kyi 'khor lo ro mnyam 'dres pa yis// bde drod ye shes lhag par 'bar bar mdzod/ 0 /rdo rje btsun mo nyi ma 'bum gyi gzis// 'od gzugs gangs ri'i dbang po zhu ba las// a wa dhu ti'i 'bar 'dzag rnam rol bas// bde stong mchog gi dpal la rol par mdzod// ches zab rnal 'byor bcu gcig la 'bad pas// nam zhig dus na dga' ma byu ru'i mdog /li khri'i skra grol dmar ser mig g.yo bas// mngon sum rig 'dzin grong du khrid par mdzod// sindhūr laṅka li yi sdong bur bcas// ro ldan gnas su bsgrubs shing yul kun tu// nyul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can// 'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' la 'khrid par mdzod// nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin 'khril shing bcom// mchog gi dhū tir zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma// tshangs pa'i sgo nas sprin lam dbyings su 'thon// khrag 'thung dpa' bor 'khyud cing rol bar mdzod// skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis// stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang*// zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rnal 'byor ma// rang ngo shes nas rtag tu skyong bar mdzod// rtsa rlung thig le e wam̐ dbyings su thim// sems nyid bde chen chos sku dpal thob nas// bgrang yas gzugs skur rnam rol dpag med kyis// 'gro kun mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par mdzod// ces brjod pas gsol ba btab la/ ༈ /de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/

tshul bzhin bshams pa'i bum pa/ nyin dang por bum par gu gul gyis bdug slob dpon gyis suṃ bha ni bzla bzhin yungs dkar gyis brab pa bcas mdzad srol yod/ sumbha ni sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam shing gis khar brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i dbus su e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar g.yon skor gyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o//

zhes brjod cing dam tshig pa bskyed de ye shes pa bstim/ go cha dgod pa dang dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa rnams ni/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de nas 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas go cha dgod pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ de nas phyi nang gi mchod cing bstod pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du kun la sbyar ba'i pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ dharma ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa byed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐

gis nang mchod phul la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod nas/ lag pa gnyis pad skor dang bcas pas gzungs thag nas bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ bum nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha sogs brgya rtsa dang*/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi ma dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags tshan gnyis po 'di'ang nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas nas gong bzhin mchod cing bstod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ mtshan sngags kun la sbyar ba'i/ pā dyaṃ nas shabda 'i mchod rol/ dharma ra ṇi sogs gong ltar mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul/ de nas rdor dril 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs shlau ka gnyis gong bzhin bstod/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol la/ dung chos kyi chu bum nang du blug la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi rje btsun ma 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/

ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la phud phul nas/ sgrub grogs gzhan thams cad la dung chos rnams su cung zad re bkye la// ༈ /de nas bdag 'jug bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis su med pa la/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur dmigs la/ dbang gi dus kyi bya ba rnams ni mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig gis mdzad cing tshig rnams ni sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis gsungs par bsam pa'am/ yang na dbang gi tshig dang bya ba thams cad mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang nyid kyis mdzad par bsam pa'ang bshad pas dmigs pa gang bde dang bcas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bum chu nas cung zad 'thung la gdong bkru ba'i tshul bya/ de nas 'jug pa'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badzra re khāe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba/ hūm̐ dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo gnyis su ma mchis pa la 'jug pa'i chos zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas yon phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/

lag par me tog cung zad dang bcas pas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas brjod par bsam ste/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gdong bcings/ yang ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba blangs/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas khaṇḍa ro hi dpag tu med pa spros te/ bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bidya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing bum chu gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod lce la bzhag pas nang gi bar chad thams cad zhi bar bsam/ de nas dri ba mdzad cing lan btab par mos la/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go / de nas nang gi sems bskyed par bsam la/ rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ de nyid mdun bskyed kyi phyag gi rdo rje rang gi snying khar bzhag nas brtan par byas par mos te/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsi ta u pa ta ya mi/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/

zhes brjod/ de nas gsang bar gdams par mdzad par bsam la/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng khyod rnal 'byor thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes brjod/ rnal 'byor ma'i phyag na gnas pa'i rdo rje la 'jus te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i drung du sleb par mos la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing rang gi lag gis rdo rje dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la mgo dud pa re bya'o// de yan gyis phyi'i 'jug pa song nas/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams gong 'phel du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /

ces lan gsum dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gi bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum/ de nas khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang sor chud cing brtan par bya'o snyam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la'ang bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*//

zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas ye shes pa dbab pa'i don du maṇḍal dang gsol ba gdab pa 'di pa'i lugs kyis bsdus pa'i phyogs ma byas kyang chog par bshad mod/ 'on kyang spros pa la dga' bas byed par spro na maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo tha mi dad pa la ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// sogs 'jug pa dang 'dra bar brjod nas/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rang gi lus la phog pas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams byang rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag rus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyes brtsegs kyi nang du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor te/ gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod cing phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can la phog pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/

sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thod khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang*/ 'phen rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i lte bar e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du bam̐ yig dmar po dang*/ de'i mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir smin mtshams kyi thad rnams su dga' ba 'khyil pa re re dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje nal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃḥ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ de nas rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bam̐ yig dga' ba 'khyil pa rnams dang bcas pa shin tu gsal ba'i dmigs pa dang ma bral ba'i ngang las/

bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pas/ bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyis byin rlabs dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam re rgyangs kyis byon nas/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍa ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas rang gi zhal du zhugs pa'i/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma des lus kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar la gar stabs kyis yang nas yang du 'khyug par mdzad de ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad nas/ mthar lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang gi bam̐ yig la thim pas de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan cing*/

ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de ltar rang gi lte ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid la sems gtad pas de nyid bde ba chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su gang bas gar stabs du ma mdzad cing sngar gyi chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi dang smin mtshams kyi thad kyi dga' ba 'khyil ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa rnams kyang g.yon phyogs su myur du 'khor ba gsal bar gyur/ de'i dus su mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs nas rang gi spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sib sib thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha sogs oṃ gsum ma'i sngags mang du brjod cing rol chen dang ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra drag tu bya/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dpag tu med pa tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon nas rang gi spyi bo nas gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod cing rol chen dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu'i sgra bya/ de ltar byin rlabs zhugs pa de nyid mi 'bral ba'i phyir oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod pas lus kyi go cha rnams dran par bya/ de nas spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod/ de nas me tog gi phreng ba bla ma rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes pas sindhū ra'i maṇḍal gyi dbus su 'bul ba'i stangs ka bya/

de nas me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ rje btsun mas rang gi spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa taṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la zhes gsungs par bsam zhing rang gi spyi bor me tog bzhag de nas dkyil 'khor mthong ba la sgrib byed bsal ba'i mtshon byed du gdong g.yogs bkrol bar mos te/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra ni tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ pa hrīḥ zhes brjod la de nas mdun bskyed kyis gsungs par bsam la/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad sku dang tsaka li lta bu ma yin pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin no// zhes brjod cing bsam pa de yan gyis 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa song nas/ de nas dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha ma'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// sogs mjug gzhan dang 'dra bar brjod la/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso// de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol cig / lan gsum/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri padma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/
