g.yon du ba dan/ khor yug tu mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de ltar mngon sum lta bur byon pa'i skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ khaṇḍa ka pā li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs rnams bskrad par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i padmor rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog / ces brjod/ de nas dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gtso mo'i thugs ka nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad byon te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsam la bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/

oṃ ka ka sye/ u lu ka sya/ shwa na ka sya/ su ka ra sye/ ya ma da dhi ye/ ya ma dhu ti ye/ ya ma daṃ ṣṭi ṇye/ ya ma ma tha ni ye/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha mdun bskyed dang bcas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur zhing rab tu gnas pas brtan par byas pa yin no// oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin du gsal ba la mchod pa mdzad par bsam la/

oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyaṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod la de nas bzlas pa'i lung ni/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/ sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung mdun bskyed kyi zhal nas 'thon/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bam̐ yig la thim zhing*/ de'i mtha' mar g.yon skor du dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas byin rlabs/ gsum pas brtan par byas par gyur/ zhes mdun bskyed kyi gsungs par bsam zhing brjod la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ des rjes zlos byas par bsam/ de nas me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlob// ces lan gcig brjod/ rje btsun mas me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu bzhag cing gsungs par bsam la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod la me tog spyi bor bzhag de nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun mas sindhū ra'i rdul tshon nas phyag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs nas/ rang gi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su thig le mdzad par bsam zhing*/ dngos su rang gi lag g.yon pas mtheb srin gyis dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga gsum du reg tsam byas la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha sogs oṃ gsum tshar gcig brjod/ de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum pa'i dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/

lam bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes brjod/ de yan gyis bum dbang bzlas lung dang bcas pa song nas/ de nas gsang dbang ni/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems thig le dung dang kunda ltar dkar ba thod pa'i nang du lhung ba/ bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rang gi lce thog tu bzhag ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha sogs oṃ gsum ma'i sngags tshar gcig dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing myong bas/ rang gi lus kyi rtsa nang gi byang sems dam tshig pa'i tshul du dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag cing gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsang ba'i dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ lam rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma utpal la gzhon nu kha 'byed pa'i man ngag bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes brjod/ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru kar gyur pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mkha' nang du byin par gyur/ ces brjod cing mdun bskyed sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dga' 'khyil sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa nas/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i phyag g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs nas/ rang gi gsang gnas/ lte ba/ snying ga

mgrin pa/ skra mtshams rnams su mas yar reg ste thig le mdzad par bsam la/ dngos su rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis/ gsang gnas/ lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ skra mtshams rnams su mas yar reg pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha sogs oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod cing*/ lag pa gnyis pad skor 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing sems kyi dmigs pa rang gi mkha' nang gi byang chub kyi sems de nyid 'og rlung bskyod pa'i stobs kyis yar drangs/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad byang sems kyis khrig mer gang bas dga' ba'i ye shes yar drangs/ snying kha'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas mchog dga'i ye shes yar drangs/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas dga' bral gyi ye shes yar drangs/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas lhan skyes kyi ye shes mngon sum du byas/ de'i tshe lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ de thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ des khyab tshad la bde bas khyab/ bde ba la stong pas khyab pas mdor na bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ lam phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes brjod/ de nas dbang bzhi pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rje btsun mas gsungs par bsam la/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes brjod de'i don thams cad kyi gnas lugs bden pa'i dngos po cung zad tsam yang ye gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bya ba 'di ni yod med rtag chad srid zhi'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bas nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/

de'i ngo bo la gzung 'dzin gyi spros pas gdod ma nas gos ma myong bas dri ma med pa/ de lta bu'i yul stong pa nyid de/ yul can gnyis snang thams cad nub pa'i gnyis med ye shes kyi rdo rje yis/ stong pa nyid du bsgom zhes zung 'jug gi ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rje btsun mas gsungs par bsam nas brjod la/ de ltar thob pa gong 'phel du byas pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams la srung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// ces lan gsum dang*/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs tshul du thob pa'i gtang rag tu dmigs nas/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen sogs maṇḍal bdun ma spyi dang 'dra ba las ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du dbang bskur ba zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi/ zhes sogs spyi dang 'dra ba brjod la/ de nas lus longs spyod la sogs pa yang yon du 'bul ba cha shas kyis longs spyod du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// lan gsum brjod/ de nas skabs 'dir spros pa la dga' bas lam srol 'di nyid kyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa dang bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas gsol 'debs bya bar 'dod na/

spyir 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang rgyud/ man ngag gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ bye brag nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa gnyis las dang po ni/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo de nyid dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi rang babs la nges shes dung pa dang bcas pas/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// zhes sogs shlau ka gcig gi rjes su/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// gang gis skye dang 'jig pa dag /ring du yongs su spangs gyur cing*// sems can kun la thams cad du// phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyud rnams kun gyi don 'dzin cing*// sems can kun la phan brtson pa'i// kun mchog rdo rje 'chang dbang la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rdzogs sangs rgyas las mngon sum du// khyed kyis chos rnams thugs chud cing*// mda' 'dzin spyod pa mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// thub pas thub par lung bstan cing*// chos rnams don ston klu sgrub mchog /bde ba can du gshegs pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// nyid kyi de nyid mchog brnyes nas// dman mos sems can don gyi phyir// rngon pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// yi ge'i sbyor ba spangs nas su// brtson pas nya rgyu gsol mdzad de// brtse bas gzhan don mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rgyal po'i bya ba rab spangs nas// sprul tshogs rjes su bsgrub mdzad de// kañtsa'i grong du grub pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rjes gnang zhing*// gzhan don spyod pa mngon sum mdzad// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dam pa'i de nyid don rtogs te// brtse bas rus sbal zhabs ldan pa// sems can smin par mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// khyod ni brtse bas grub brnyes te// 'bar bas 'bar ba'i spyod 'dzin zhing*// kun la phan par mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// nus pa la ni mnga' brnyes shing*// spyod pa kun gyi rmad byung ba// 'jig rten 'dren pa mdzad pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gu hya pa// brtse bas log 'dren rnal 'byor ma// btul nas 'gro ba skyong ba la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// mi mthun phyogs rnams rab spangs te// dkar po rnam par 'phel mdzad pa// rnam par rgyal pa'i zhabs pad la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// grub nas grub pa'i lam ston cing*// 'grol nas rnam par phan mdzad pa// bar ma'i slob dpon dam pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// til brdungs pas ni rab grub pa// skal ldan gzhan la brtse ba can// mu stegs rnam par sun 'byin la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bram ze las ni rab byung zhing*// gnas lnga la ni rab sbyangs shing*// dka' bas dam pa bsten pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// shes bya la ni rab sbyangs shing*// nus pas kun la thogs med ldan// pha na phem gur grags pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// skad gnyis smra ba'i mchog gyur cing*// shes rab ldan pas phan mdzad pa// brtsegs pa'i mtha' dang ldan pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// brtson pas dka' ba cher mdzad de// rgyud kun 'dzin mdzad skad gnyis smra// rje btsun blo gros grags pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum du// khyod la byin gyis brlabs pa yis// shes bya kun la thogs med ldan// rgyud rnams kun gyi bdag por gyur// kun dga'i snying por grags pa yis// dpal ldan sa skyar bzhugs gyur cing*// bde ba can du gshegs pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gang gi sras kyi thu bo pa// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs pa'i// gnas lnga la ni rab mkhas shing*// bsod nams ye shes rtser gyur pa// nyid kyi gzhan don rdzogs mdzad nas// 'jig rten rnams ni gzhug pa'i phyir// bde ba can du mngon sum gshegs// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// khyed kyi thugs ni 'jam dbyangs ltar// shes bya kun la rab mkhas shing*// 'jig rten kun la rtsa lag ltar// dgongs pas khyod kyi grags pa yis// rgyal mtshan dri ma med pa thob// ngo mtshar du ma'i spyod pa 'dzin// kun nas yon tan ldan khyod la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// brtse bas sems can thams cad la// dpal 'byor chen po'i 'od zer gyis// rtag par skyong bar mdzad khyod la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ngur smrig gis// chos gos 'dzin par legs sprul pa'i// sa skya paṇa chen zhabs pad la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal 'byor dang*// mkhas shing grub pa'i blo gros can// chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// sbyangs pa'i yon tan lhur mdzad pa'i// rim pa gnyis la thugs brtan pa// zhang ston dkon mchog dpal ba la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bla ma'i zhabs tog dka' ba spyad// rtse gcig sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// grub chen bsod nams dpal ba la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung ste// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khrir 'khod pa'i// 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i dpal ldan zhing*// rnam dag tshul khrims gos bzang can// rgyal sras rdo rje 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gnyis med ye shes legs gzigs shing*// gzhan phan lhag bsam cher bskyed pa'i// chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// e wam̐ rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu// zung 'jug chos kyi sku brnyes pa// kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gcig tu bsgrub la brtson mdzad cing*// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa'i// mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams gangs ri'i spor gnas shing*// lung dang rigs pa'i mche lder can// kun mkhyen smra ba'i seṅge la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rig pa'i gnas kun rab sbyangs te// grub pa'i sa brnyes chos kyi rje// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog dges pa'i mthu ldan zhing*// mkha' ltar yangs pa'i blo gros can// grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med cing*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// nges don gdams pa 'phel mdzad pa// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen pas shes bya'i de nyid gzigs// brtse dang nus pa rmad byung ba// rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// dam chos rin chen kun gyi gter// dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs shing*// grub pa'i byin rlabs bka' babs pa// 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// snyigs dus dpal ldan sa skya pa'i// bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog gyur pa'i// sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho// snyigs dus slar yang mi yi zol// sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rje btsun sems dpa' chen po nyid// 'khor lo sdom par mngon sum du// legs gzigs sangs rgyas dpal bzang la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan bla ma lhag pa'i lhas// rjes bzung chos kyi rgyal po gang*// lung rtogs yon tan mdzod 'dzin la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gang gi gsung gi bdud rtsi las// legs 'khrungs bzang po'i chu skyes mchog

/skal ldan bung ba'i dpal gyur la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen rab nam mkha' ltar yangs pas// shes bya kun la dbang phyug pa'i// paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan 'khor lo bde mchog dang*// dbyer med chos kyi 'byung gnas che// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i dbang phyug la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// sbyin bya bzhi dang blang bya gnyis// drod dang spyod pa mthar phyin pa'i// khyab bdag sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma yis// rjes bzung sngags 'chang sa skya pa// ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rmad byung dam pa'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mdzod gyur pa// ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// gsan bsam bsgom pa mthar son nas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas gzhan don mdzad// byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// bla ma rnams dang lhag pa'i lhas// rjes bzung phrin las mtha' yas pa// sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rgyal sras thu bo 'jam pa'i dbyangs// 'od gsal 'chi med gdung 'dzin pa// 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rin chen la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// sras bcas rgyal ba'i ye shes sku// snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog /sa chen kun dga' blo gros la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'chi med sku brnyes mtsho skyes rje'i// gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i gar// 'jam mgon dbang sdud snying po la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo nyid// ngur smrig bla gos 'chang ba'i zol// 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis// grub pa gnyis kyi mthar phyin pa// sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// phyi nang rig gzhung rgya mtsho gzigs// grub pa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// 'dren mchog rdo rje rin chen la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug brtse ba che'i// zab gsang snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i bdag

/skal bzang chos kyi nyi ma la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya pa'i// chos kyi srid la dbang bsgyur ba// drag shul 'phrin las rin chen la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// mkhas shing grub pa'i gtsug rgyan che// yongs rdzogs bstan pa rgya mtsho'i bdag /mkhan chen 'jam dpal bzang po la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dngos// dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel ba// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// dngos kun khyab bdag bde ba'i mchog /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i he ru ka /shes rab sgyu ma'i btsun mo dang*// rol mdzad bde ba chen por 'dud// zung 'jug de nyid ma thob bar// rje btsun bla mas rjes bzung ste// mngal sgong rdzus skyes dkyil 'khor du// sbyin bya dbang bzhis smin par shog /zab mo'i lam gyi rtsa ba mchog /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i// 'khor lo sdom pa'i dam tshig rnams// ma nyams tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog /ma dag skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba'i// gsal dag bskyed rim legs bsgoms te// snang ba lha ru 'char ba dang*// zhi sogs phrin las dbang bsgyur shog /brgyud rim gnas lugs shes byas nas// sngags rim gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyis// ye shes dga' bzhi'i rim pa bskyed// gsang ba'i rim pa 'grub par shog /de ltar rim gnyis la brtson pas// drod thob spyod pas mtshams sbyar te// rab dga' la sogs sa bgrod nas// rtse gcig phyag chen 'grub par shog /khyad par skye ba 'di nyid la// mtshan 'dzin kun rtog rab spangs nas// ḍeṃ gi dha ri ka pa bzhin// gsang chen spyod pa mthar phyin shog /'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// nam yang mi 'bral gnas gsum gyi// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang lhan cig gnas// rig 'dzin dbang po nyid gyur cig /bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro'i nus mthu yis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun// zung 'jug rdo rje'i sa thob shog

ces pa 'di'i/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ shlau ka gcig ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod nas 'byung ba yin la/ gang gis skye dang 'jig pa dag /ces sogs nas/ rtag tu skyong bar mdzad khyod la// zhes pa'i bar rnams chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad cing*/ de'i rjes su/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ngur smrig gi /zhes sogs nas/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la// zhes pa'i bar gyi kha skong rnams/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du/ bde mchog gi rgyud bshad rgyas par gnang ba'i tshe mdzad pa yin la/ dngos kun khyab bdag bde ba'i mchog /ces sogs lam rim gyi smon lam 'di rnams/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pas/ bde mchog srin po rir tshes bcu'i mchod pa zhig gis tshe mdzad par bshad pas/ brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di rnams 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa'i skyes chen dam pa 'ba' zhig gi gsung yin pas byin rlabs shin tu che'o// 'di ni sngags 'chang chen po'i gsol 'debs 'di bdag gi bla ma dbang po'i mtshan can gyis mdzad par snang la/ gzhan gsol 'debs kyi kha bskang rnams ni kho bos byas so// de ltar 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang brgyud man ngag gi bla ma brgyud pa spyi la gsol ba btab nas/ bye brag nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen nā ro ta pa pham thing pa// shes rab brtsegs dang mal lo sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje 'chang dang mus chen sems dpa' che// bsod nams seṅge buddha ratna'i zhabs// sa skya lo tstsha sngags 'chang chos kyi rje// 'jam dbyangs sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas dpal bzang dpal ldan rgyal po dang*// bzang po dpal ba paṇa chen nam dbang mtshan// rje btsun chos dbang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun dga' bsod nams bsod nams dbang phyug dang*// kun dga' bkra shis bsod nams rin chen zhabs// kun dga' blo gros dbang sdud snying po dang*// bstan pa'i nyi ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun dga' rin chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang*// rdo rje rin chen skal bzang chos nyi zhabs// karma ratna 'jam dpal bzang po sogs// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bskyed rim zab mo mkha' spyod rnal 'byor dang*// rdzogs rim dbu ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mthus// bde chen lhan skyes ye shes skye ba dang*// mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs//

zhes pa 'di ni rdo rje 'chang*/ kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong dang bcas pa ste/ de ltar brgyud 'debs rgyas bsdus gnyis char ram/ bsdus pa rkyang pa la sogs pa gang 'os skabs dang sbyar nas byas pa'i rjes su/ ༈ /yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs pa rnams thun mong du byin rlabs pa ni/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor ma rnams la gtor la/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ go las ba lang gi sha/ shar du ku las khyi'i sha/ byang du da las glang po che'i sha/ nub tu ha las rta'i sha/ lhor na las mi'i sha/ de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ dbus su bi las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang sems/ nub tu ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rakta/ de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bhrūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nub tu dzrīṃ las so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar zhing rdzas rnams zhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/

yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par byung nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba gtor ma la thim/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī/ zhes pas sngags lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas yi dam kyai rdo rje dang*/ bde mchog 'khor lo gnyis la gtor chog bzhin phul nas/ mkha' spyod ma'i gtor ma la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin rlabs dran par byas la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ma la gnyis su med par thim zhing*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams mtha' skor du bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ lha de thams cad kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ pad skor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha sogs/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags dang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a dya nutpan na twa da oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lnga'am bdun gyis phul la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du kun la sbyar ba'i/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ dharmā ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pā ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐

gis nang mchod phul/ ḍā dril rol chen dang bcas pa/ oṃ na mo bha ga wā ti badzra wā ra hi hūm̐ hūm̐ḥphaṭa/ oṃ na mo ārya a pā ra dzi te trai lo kya mā te mahā bi dye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha ya wa he ma hā badzre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra a sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa shyaṅka ri ne tra bhra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa ni shwa ṣa ni ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na massaṃ trā sa ni mā ra ni su pra bhe da ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥpa rā dza ye bi dzaḥye dzambha ni stambha ni mo hā ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra wā ra hī ma hā yo gi ni ka me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pa'i bar rkang pa brgyad kyis bstod nas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis// bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu gyur cig / ces pas gsol ba btab nas/ de nas gur gyi mgon po lcam dral/ zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug gdong bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ phrin las rab tu myur ba'i las mkhan pū tra lcam sring*/ bstan skyong ma mo kun gyi gtso mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod phreng can/ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gzhi bdag rnams la/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i gtor chog nang bzhin phul la/ de nas bzlas pa/ bshags pa/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren bskang ba/ bstod pa/ gtor 'bul sogs bla ma gong ma'i phyag len bzhin rgyas bsdus long skabs dang sbyar nas byas la/ slob ma sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs byed dgos/ yod na skabs 'dir bya'o// 'di'i rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa'i gang zag ni/ rab bde mchog lū nag gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa/

'bring 'khor lo bde mchog gang rung*/ tha na'ang kye rdor man ngag lugs lta bu gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung du dbang thob cing*/ 'di'i sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par nos nas/ bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang*/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i khrid sogs dang*/ de dag gi rgyab rten rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig rnams las byung ba ltar gyi nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa rnams kyi bshad pa lung la sogs pa mtha' yas par thob nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yum rkyang ngam/ yab yum gnyis med kyi sgo nas/ sarba buddha la bzhi 'bum la sogs pa'i bsnyen pa las su rung ba zhig byung ba mchog tu gyur pa gsungs la/ gal te nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid sogs chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa ma thob cing rnal 'byor ma yum rkyang ngam/ bde mchog yab yum gnyis kyi sgo nas sarba buddha la bzhi 'bum sogs kyi bsnyen pa ma grub kyang*/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi dbang dang byin rlabs tshul bzhin du thob cing*/ kyai rdor lta bu'i gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pa zhig ni/ lugs 'di'i rdo rje slob dpon bya ba la cis kyang dgos pa yin te/ deng sang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i grub mtha'i srol 'dzin gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal che ba'i phyag len de kho na ltar mdzad pa dang*/ sngon gyi bla ma gong ma 'khrul ba zad pa rnams kyis gsung rgyun dag las kyang de dang 'dra bar byung bas/ rang re rjes 'jug rnams thugs rtog zhib len mdzad pa gal che'o// ༈ /de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ sumbha ni sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog

bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhuṣpaṃ/ ā lo ke gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlabs/ de nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du kun la sbyor ba'i pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ dharmā ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa byed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pā ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing*/ gtor mgron sogs kyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs spyi dang 'dra ba byas la/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel te byed na/ nub dang po rnams la/ bye brag tu yang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor de nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams ji srid gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣṭha zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/

de nas gtor mgron rten med pa rnams la gshegs gsol byas la/ go cha dgod pa/ tshams rngam sngags kyis srung ba/ dga' ba gsum dran pa/ smon lam bkra shis sogs byed/ sgrub mchod grol ba'i mjug chog gi tshe/ bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa'ang sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi drung du bzhag gong du bshad pa ltar rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs kyi rjes su/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa dang*/ bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs dang*/ badzra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces go cha dgod/ sumbha ni tshar gnyis brjod cing sdig mdzub phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor bstan la/ tshams rngam sngags kyis srung*/ hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rang bzhin/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha sogs tshar gcig brjod la/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin/ hūm̐ sems kyi rnam par thar pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin no// zhes pas dga' ba gsum dran par byas nas/ de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog

/'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas kyang*// rol mo sgra snyan glu dbyangs sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis// bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /

ces sogs kyi smon lam rgya cher btab la/ de nas bkra shis bya ba ni/ rje btsun byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bkra shis dge legs kyi dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di nyid bya ste/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// rdo rje 'chang dbang paṇa chen nā ro sogs// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyi// byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i yum mchog shes rab pha rol phyin// rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas spros dang bral// brtan g.yo dngos kun spro dang sdud mdzad ma// mkha' spyod chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rab mdzes brjid pa'i sku// drug cu'i dbyangs ldan theg mchog sgrogs pa'i gsung*// ye shes lnga ldan bde gsal mi rtog thugs// lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bkra shis shog /sna tshogs zhing du sna tshogs gzugs sku yis// sna tshogs thabs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya'i don// sna tshogs bsam pa ji bzhin sgrub mdzad ma// zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog /padma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rje btsun ma// 'dzum khro'i nyams ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// gri thod legs 'dzin zhabs zung brkyangs bskum tshul// sngags skyes mkha' spyod mchog gi bkra shis shog /gang gi rnam sprul grangs med bye ba phrag /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis tshogs rnams kyis// sgrub pa po yi bar chad kun sel zhing*// 'dod don dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog / ces pa dang*/ gzhan yang chos skyong nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing sgrub khang gi phyogs kun tu me tog gi char chen po dbab par bya'o// 'di lta bu'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zab mo'i lam gyi dbang dang byin rlabs/ gdams pa'i tshogs rnams thos nas gang zag dbang po rab kyis bzlas sgom kho na chag med du nyams su blangs shing*/

'di rang gi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa byas/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang mar ngo'i nyer lnga ste tshes bcu gnyis kyis mchod pa la brtson par byas pa tsam gyis/ re zhig na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal gyi bud med kyi rnam par 'byon zhing*/ de ltar byon pa de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa la yin par ngo shes/ des rnal 'byor pa'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste/ lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du khyer bar bshad cing*/ gang zag dbang po 'bring gis de ltar nyams su blangs kyang*/ rtags sogs ci yang ma byung na/ 'di rang gi bsnyen pa yi ge'i grangs kyi 'bum tshar gnyis tsam bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa dang laṅka ling ka'i shing la brten nas sindhu ra bsgrub pa'i sgrub pa byas/ de rjes sindhū ra des rang gi dpral bar dga' ba 'khyil bar bri zhing*/ 'phang ra lta bu'i bud med mang du tshogs pa'i sar phyin nas/ rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal brtan pas bltas pa'i tshe/ bud med gang gi dpral bar me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin dga' 'khyil 'phos nas/ de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid yin pas/ g.yon nas bskor ba sogs gsol ba btab pas/ des rang gi mkhrig ma nas bzung ste mkha' spyod du khyer bar gsungs pa ni/ 'bring bsnyen sgrub las gsum la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub pa zhes bya ba yin la/ gang zag dbang po tha mas/ de lta bu'i bya ba ma grub pa'am/ grub kyang ji lta ba bzhin ma byung na da dung sgyid lug mi bya bar bzlas sgom nan tan du nyams su blangs pas/ nam zhig 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku las bar dor langs pa na/ rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i bzlas sgom byed pa'i snang ba 'byung zhing*/ de la brten nas dus de nyid du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pas sgrub pa po seṅge'i khri la bzhag 'ja'i gur phub/ me tog gi char 'bebs bzhin pas mkha' spyod du khyer ba ni nges pa yin par gsungs la/

de lta bu'i mkha' spyod la yang*/ mkha' spyod chen po ni sangs rgyas kyi sa yin la/ mkha' spyod chung ngu ni 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad nam mkha' las 'byung ba/ tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar du thub cing rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro nus pas sprul sku las dngos su chos nod cing*/ sprul sku'i zhing khams rnams su thogs med bgrod nus pas/ tshe de la sangs rgyas nges pa gcig yin par bshad de/ de ltar mchog tu zab cing shin tu 'grub thag nye ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam 'di nyid la brten nas rgya bod kyi skyes chen grangs med pa zhig mkha' spyod du byon pa'i lo rgyus byung yang*/ 'dir skal bzang rnams spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun rnam thar sogs nas byung ba ltar rags rim zhig khungs bstan tsam brjod na/ rgya gar 'phags yul du/ grub chen dril bu pa/ dpal nā ro pa chen po/ a bha ya kā ra sogs 'di'i lam la brten nas grub thob bya khyu 'phur ba ltar byung ba'i tshul dang*/ bod gangs can 'dir yang*/ pu hrang lo tsā bas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod grub tshul/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i slob ma sgom pa mo'i lo rgyus dang*/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la mkha' spyod nas spyan 'dren byung tshul/ na bza' brag phug pa'i nye gnas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon tshul/ yang na bza' brag phug pa'i slob ma bdun lus ma spangs par song tshul/ grub chen buddha pa'i slob ma zhe dgon pa'i dge slong de ba ma ti nyer lnga la mkha' spyod mas spyan drangs tshul/ bla ma dam pa mkha' spyod mas rjes su bzung tshul/ sngags 'chang gzungs pa la rnal 'byor mas byi ru dmar po'i skas dngos su btsugs tshul/ bzang po rgyal mtshan gyi gdung la rnal 'byor ma rang byon 'khrungs tshul/ bla chen chos dpal bas sindhū ra'i bsgrub pa byas pas khong gshegs dus/

rnal 'byor ma'i sku rang byon 'phel tshul/ khams pa bsod nams bzang po rnal 'byor mas mkha' spyod la dngos su khyer tshul/ shar chen ye rgyal la rnal 'byor mas/ 'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di// mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas su 'khyer// zhes pa'i lung bstan byung pa dang*/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi slob ma tsha ba rong pa shākya rgyal mtshan 'phan yul gyi ri las lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs tshul/ yang tsha ba rong pa bsod nams bzang po/ tsha rong gi ri las 'chi khar mkha' spyod du gshegs tshul/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i slob ma gsum mkha' spyod du dngos su gshegs pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ paṇa chen gung ru la rnal 'byor mas dngos su rjes su bzung tshul/ chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po la rje btsun mas rakta dbu zhwa'i nang du stsal tshul/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang la nang mchod kyi steng du rnal 'byor ma mtshon gang ba dngos su byon nas zhal bstan tshul/ srid pa kun blo la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mi'i bu mo dngos kyi rnam par bstan tshul dang*/ khong byang chen du gshegs pa rnal 'byor mas bsu ba'i 'od zer dge ldan pas mthong bas brang brdungs tshul/ rje btsun kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas 'pho ba legs par thebs tshul/ pu hreng rnal 'byor pa rnal 'byor ma la brten nas bar chad bsal tshul dang gdung la rnal 'byor ma byon tshul/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa la mnal lam du/ rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung tshul/ kun mkhyen rin po che dang*/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyang rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba la brten nas bde ba can du gshegs tshul/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal ba'i bud med kyi sogs rnam 'phrul du mas mngon sum du zhal yang yang bstan tshul/ bdag gi bla ma rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can de nyid la rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma shar dros la bsam gtan phu'i gzim phug tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi bsu ba dngos su byon nas de dag dang gsung gleng mdzad pa rje dpon gyis gnam sgo'i steng gi gzim phug gi mdo nas thos tshul/

de nas nyer gcig gi nam langs la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag zab mo 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor gsal 'debs par mdzad de/ phaṭa che ba gnyis dang hig chung ngu zhig gsung ba'i mod la/ de ma thag dbu ma nas chu bskol ba lta bu'i rlangs pa chen po skya bun pa dang bcas skad cig nyid la dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga zangs thal du gyur pa nas rtsa dbu ma lta bu'i sbom phra smyug ma 'bring po tsam gyi rtsa sbubs stong zhing rgyangs kyis 'thon pa las byang sems nyil le ba dang bcas thogs pa med par mkha' spyod chen po 'og min du gshegs pa'i tshul/ snar thang sde pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pas dge ldan pa'i sku mang po bshig cing sdig pa bsags kyang*/ gshegs dus rnal 'byor ma la bsten nas dbu gtsug 'phar tshul/ bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje'i gdung la oṃ gsum ma byon tshul/ sgrub chen pa seṅge grags gshegs dus sindhū ra'i char babs tshul/ de la sogs te rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod 'di'i lam la brten nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma thob pa'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa zhig byung bas skal bzang rnams 'di'i bzlas bsgom chag med du bgyid cing bsnyen sgrub sogs la 'bad pa dang*/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa bgyid pa'ang*/ skal pa bzang por shes par byas nas yid dga' yal le shes pa spro seng ba'i ngang nas chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rnam rtog rgyang ring du spangs te/ tshig don la sems rtse gcig tu bsgril te nyams su len pa zhu/ de dag gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blangs pa'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba legs par bstan zin to// 'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos kyi bcud// dpal mo mkha' spyod dga' ma'i nye lam mchog /dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun gser chos gang*// dpal mchog he ru ka dpal mus pa rje'i/

1 /gsung gi bcud 'di 'di phyir phan 'dod rnams// brtson pas legs sgrub bsgrub na 'khor ba las// nges par myur grol grol ba mchog thob 'gyur// de phyir skal bzang bzang po'i las 'phro can/ 2 /snying dbus bzhugs pa'i mkha' spyod dbang mo de// snying nas bsgrub par 'dod pa'i blo can rnams// snying gi gdams pa mkha' spyod myur lam 'di// snying ltar gces par bzung la don gnyis bsgrub/ 3 /rab 'byams rgyud sde'i snying po gsang ba'i gtam// rab mang mkhas grub bye ba gshegs pa'i lam// rab mchog rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab las// rab grub blo yis legs par btus te sbyar/ 4 /nam yang tshe 'di'i las la zin med cing*// nam 'chi cha med nges par 'chi ba'i tshul// nam gyi srod dang tho rangs legs bsam na// nam yang chos med dal bar 'dug phod dam/ 5 /bdag 'dra dam pa'i rigs su skyes mod kyang*// bdag tu 'dzin pa chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis// bdag yid dam du bcings pa 'di bsam na// bdag ni phyi ma gar skye a tsa ma/ ngan song las ma 'das pas/ 6 /'on kyang rdo rje 'chang dngos rje dang mjal// mjal bar ma zad gdams pa rgya mtsho thos// thos tsam min pa thugs yid gcig tu 'dres// 'dres pas 'di phyi'i don kun lhun gyis grub/ 7 /des na bdag dang bdag gi gdul bya kun// kun mkhyen ma thob bar du yongs 'dzin rje// rje btsun khyed las lhag pa'i skyabs gzhan med// med phyir 'bral med thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol/ 8 /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams// 'dir ni tshe ring don gnyis mthar phyin te// 'di nas mkha' 'gro'i mngon sum mdun bsus nas// 'di phyir 'bral med don kun grub 'gyur cig 9 /ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blangs pa'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba 'di ni/

khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa chen po rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang*/ rje btsun mus pa chen po 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can/ rje nag dgon pa sbyin pa grags pa grub pa mchog gi ded dpon chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan la sogs te/ yongs 'dzin dam pa du ma las gdams pa rgya mtsho'i bka' drin nos shing*/ khyad par rje btsun mus pa chen po las/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yab chos nying khu 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ nā ro mkha' spyod dang bcas pa'i dbang byin rlabs bskyed rdzogs kyi zab khrid rgyud dang rgya bod kyi tshad ldan gyi gzhung du ma'i bshad lugs sogs mdor na rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' drin nos pa'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gzhan thams cad mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang bsgrub pa'i slad du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgya gzhung gi dgongs 'grel tshad mar gyur pa/ dpal sa skya pa'i gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i yig cha tshad ldan du ma zhig gi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ dpal sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*/ kun mkhyen rin po che/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ paṇa chen gung ru/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ rje tshar chen yab sras/ rje kun dga' grol mchog thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga byin rlabs kyi yi ge sogs gsung rab de dag gi dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa yin pas kho bos rang bzo cung zad kyang med do/

/rgya gar lugs la kṣa ya zhes pa zad pa dang*/ rgya nag lugs la me pho stag gi lo/ phal ghunaḥzhes pa'i dus kyi dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas kyi bzhi thog bla brang gi sa gsum gyi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri padma can gyi drung ga la ba der legs par sbyar ba'o// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa dpag tu med pa 'byung zhing bdag cag dpon slob thams cad tshe 'di'am/ 'chi kha'am/ bar dor mkha' spyod dbang mos rjes su bzung nas/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'dren nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig/ ༈ /yang smras pa/ kho bos byas pa'i sgrub dkyil 'di nyid ni// tshad ldan gong ma'i gsung rab mang po las// btus phyir phyogs re mthong ba rgyu mtshan du// byas nas lugs 'dir som nyi ma byed cig /ces kyang gdams pa ste rgyu mtshan spros pas chog go /sarba maṅga lam//

༈ / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bkra shis glo bo mkhan chen pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// shrī tsakra sambha ra ya/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i padmar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi 'byung gnas nyams dga' bar// sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed gdan la bde bar bzhugs// rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum gyur rnal 'byor ma// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig gsang chen zab mo'i don ston pa// mkha' 'gro grangs mang gsung gi snying po sum cu gnyis// sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer bye ba'i 'phro 'du can// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig 'gyur med lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings// khams gsum kun la bde ba chen po khyab pa'i thugs// tshad med yon tan phrin las tshogs kyi cher 'bar ba// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig zhing skyong ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyis// bdud dang bgegs 'joms zhi rgyas dbang gi las mdzad cing*// srung ba'i 'khor lo rgya chen rtag tu gnas gyur pa// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis 'di sgrub mchod kyi cha rkyen du dge slong pu ṇyas bris pa lags/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis 'di/ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod kyi tshe/ bdag 'jug gi dbang gi bkra shis kyi skabs su mdzad par zhu/ rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis 'di glo bo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub nyid kyi phyag bris dngos rgya shog ser po'i logs la 'god par mdzad/ dad pa'i dbang gis sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi lag tu byung ba las zhal bshus dag par bgyis pa 'dis 'phral du bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig/

//de ltar dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod sor bzhag thog sogs khongs 'ga' shas kha bskang zhing*/ phyag len skor gsal kha phran bu zhabs tog gi tshul du sbyar nas/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu lug lor ra dza pur dpal sa skya'i chos sgar gyi tshogs gzhung 'don byar dmigs te/ sa skya sgrol ma pho brang gi khri 'dzin ngag dbang kun dgas gsar sgrigs kyi rgyu yon sbyar nas rgyal yongs sa chen glog klad nang bcug nas par du bskrun pa 'dis kyang rgyal bstan spyi dang*/ brtse chen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // sras bcas rgyal kun yum gyur rje btsun ma// rdo rje btsun mo'i gzugs su yongs shar ba// padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan rnal 'byor ma'i// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa 'bul// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
